language_options.option: Rust/Tauri writes a versioned JSON manifest
language_options.reason: Rust already owns app-data path resolution and can atomically refresh the overview before returning the report to the UI.
Would keep product data inside webview/browser storage instead of the platform runtime data plane.
Useful when concurrent querying and transactional history become primary, but it would require backup, migration, and WAL operational design beyond this slice.

architecture_options.option: Keep only transient raw directory scans
architecture_options.reason: Does not create a durable storage format for installed-shell UI reads.

architecture_options.option: Versioned overview manifest over existing file-record stores
architecture_options.reason: Adds a stable query artifact without destructive migration or loss of file-level provenance.

folder_structure_options.option: Store manifest beside each raw record folder
folder_structure_options.reason: Scatters overview state through raw stores and weakens the user-visible index boundary.
Makes indexes a clear app-data runtime plane and keeps future index versions discoverable.
